Name: Robin Work Hours - Continued
Author: CyanFire
Description:
This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11244]Robin Work Hours[/url] by aedenthorn


In the vanilla game, Robin is working on construction immediately at 6 AM and doesn't stop, basically until the construction is complete.

This mod gives her reasonable hours (default 9 AM to 5 PM) and causes her to
walk to and from construction sites, letting her carry out her
remaining schedule and go to sleep at a reasonable hour!

Also, this lets you talk and give gifts to her outside of work hours.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/CyanFireUK/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/CyanFireUK/StardewValleyMods[/url].
